historical_red.observation: The initial four reflection-only discovery probes failed because the approved T042 Store/coordinator/activator seams were absent. They were replaced by direct typed tests after those seams landed.

corrective_red_baseline.observed: Both first-attempt Integrity/Security failures returned RetryScheduled and left execution and coordination Running before the T042 correction.

current_verification.build: successful; exit code 0; zero compile errors
current_verification.database: Two uniquely named disposable PostgreSQL 17 databases were created by the approved harness. Each test explicitly disposed its database and then queried pg_database through the administrator connection to assert absence.

covered_vectors.serial_canonical_claims: ClaimNextAsync claims the lowest GroupOrder first and a concurrent PostgreSQL claimant cannot create a second active lease.
covered_vectors.one_active_job: A second claim observes the existing active lease while the next group remains Pending.
covered_vectors.lease_expiry_and_restart: An expired first-attempt lease is reclaimed with the same execution, job, Flow Group, and retrieval-budget identity as attempt two.
covered_vectors.one_durable_job_local_retry: A due retry is reclaimed once, a third attempt is prohibited, and durable retrieval counters are preserved.
covered_vectors.provider_pause_and_manual_resume: Provider pause releases the lease without charging an attempt; execution identity and durable state survive resume.
covered_vectors.authenticated_activation: Coordinator Start/Resume use IUserContext and never accept caller-supplied Repository/System/revision/provider authority.
covered_vectors.integrity_security_terminalization: Integrity and Security failures atomically release the lease, fail the job, transition Pass2Execution and coordination to matching terminal states, preserve prior Documents, and prohibit later claims.
covered_vectors.postgresql_serialization: Fresh PostgreSQL qualification proves one active claim under concurrency plus expired-lease/due-retry recovery with stable job and budget identity.

postgresql_qualification.note: The test-owned harness validates each unique database name before create/drop and explicitly asserts post-drop absence.
